params.body:
The workbench's mail sessions turn each request in a forwarded mail into a GitHub issue (`issue.open`, a judged write through the gateway; portal-cli `mail-intake.mjs`). To see whether a request is already tracked, a session reads the open issues with its hourly read token, and that token gets 403 on issues: it can open an issue it cannot read.

`ReadPermissions` gains `"issues": "read"`. Every value stays `read`; the test that no read token asks for anything but `read` still holds, and a new assertion pins `issues`. Reading issues reaches no further than the pull requests the token already reads, which carry the same discussions. The App itself already has issues permission, since it opens them.

`go test ./...` passes.

## To roll out (operator)

1. Merge, then tag the release on the Mac (YubiKey):
   ```bash
   git clone --filter=blob:none git@github.com:abovebeyond-ai/control.git /tmp/ctl && cd /tmp/ctl
   git tag v0.31.0 && git push origin v0.31.0 && cd && rm -rf /tmp/ctl
   ```
2. The release workflow builds `control-gateway-linux-amd64`. A follow-up pull request moves `deploy/gcp/startup.sh` and the README to v0.31.0 with its sha256.
3. After that one is merged, on the Mac:
   ```bash
   gcloud auth login shane@abovebeyond.ai
   cd ~/Projects/control && git pull && CONTROL_GCP_PROJECT=elixir-508105 deploy/gcp/rehearse.sh upgrade
   gcloud auth revoke --all
   ```
params.title: A read token reads issues
